3637163.name: Beit Chabad Caballito Sur
3637163.note: 'Inauguracion del Beit Jabad Caballito Sur. 27 de Septiembre del 2016 - 25 de Elul del 5776. Aproximadamente a las 20.00 hs. en la Avenida Directorio 1398 ... se realizó la ceremonia de Apertura de una nueva sede de Beit Jabad, "Caballito Sur" ... los rabinos Gabriel Setton y Shloimi Setton' (Periodismo Kosher, Oct 2016); 'Cena por el Primer Aniversario del Beit Jabad Caballito Sur', 13 Sept 2017. Later at Bertres 339 (Caballito's annex in Jabad Argentina's list). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2019-09-12.

3106002.name: Beit Jabad Barracas
3106002.note: Chanukah in Plaza Colombia (Montes de Oca and Brandsen), 3 Dec 2013: 'Cabe destacar que esta es la primera vez que se realiza este tipo de actos en el barrio de Barracas ... Periodismo Kosher agradece a Shneor Mizrahi' (Periodismo Kosher). 'The Chabad representative to Barracas' Rabbi Shneor Mizrahi found La Boca's 1907 synagogue 'six years ago' (lubavitch.com, Sept 2019): so about 2013. Beit Jabad Barracas, Azara 710 (Oct 2017); 'Beit Jabad de Boca y Barracas' (Sept 2018, Periodismo Kosher); today Rocha 1467. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2015-10-27.

3407840.name: Beit Jabad San Fernando - Tigre
3407840.note: Not in Jabad Argentina's list of Sept or Nov 2012 (Wayback copies); in it by 29 March 2013: 'BEIT JABAD SAN FERNANDO – TIGRE, Director: Rabino Moshé Abudarham, Constitución 1470 – San Fernando'. 'el Rab. Moshé Abudarah del Beit Jabad Sº Fernando de Tigre' (Periodismo Kosher, Sept 2013); 'Una charla con el Rabino Moshe Abudharam, Director del Beit Jabad San Fernando, quien nos cuenta acerca de los primeros pasos de esta nueva comunidad' (jabad.tv, 31 July 2014). So about 2013 (or the end of 2012). Radio Jai (July 2020) has him rabbi there 'desde hace más de 16 años', which seems to count his years with Beit Jabad Zona Norte. Its first Sefer Torah came in Sept 2017 (Itón Gadol). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2016-08-17.

6294766.name: Beit Jabad Bajo Belgrano
6294766.note: 'Rabbi and Mrs. Chanina Grunblatt, Beit Jabad, Bajo Belgrano, Argentina' among Merkos' new libraries (COLlive, 17 Nov 2022), and 'Rabbi and Mrs. Chanina and Shterna Grunblatt, Buenos Aires, Argentina' among the sixty 'New Shluchim Grants' (two-year grants for new shluchim; COLlive and CrownHeights.info, 19 Nov 2022): new in 2022. Not in Esencia's directory of Dec 2022; in it from March 2023. Castañeda 1871, Golf Square; today Rabbi Dovid and Sheyne Sara Grunblatt (chabad.org). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2024-01-25.

6620858.name: ISEJ Belgrano-Jabad
6620858.note: 'Rabbi and Mrs. Yoel Migdal, ISEJ Belgrano, Buenos Aires, Argentina' among the final recipients of Merkos' libraries (COLlive, 21 April 2023): the first mention found. ISEJ Belgrano is at O'Higgins 2358 (Jabad Argentina's list), the address of the old Beit Jabad Belgrano (Rabbi Shlomo Kiesel; 'Establecido: Elul 5747 – Septiembre de 1987'), which was under a government intervention from June 2022 (Ministry of Justice resolution 557; call for members, Sept 2022, Itón Gadol). So it began between late 2022 and April 2023. ISEJ itself opened in 2006. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2025-06-09.

extra-argentina-belgrano-beit-menajem.name: Jabad Beit Menajem Belgrano
extra-argentina-belgrano-beit-menajem.note: 'Hajnasat Sefer Tora en Beit Menajem Belgrano. 9 de Agosto del 2017 - 17 de Menajem Av del 5777 ... en el Templo Beit Menajem Belgrano, ubicado en Ciudad de la Paz 2555' (Periodismo Kosher): the first mention found (Or Mizrah's building, where that blog reported events in 2013-2014 with no Beit Menajem). A second Sefer Torah there in Sept 2022 ('Beit Jabad Menajem, sito en Ciudad de la Paz 2555'); at Olazábal 2287 by March 2024. Low: it may be older than 2017. Esencia's directory has it only from about Sept 2023. Rabbi Abrumi and Daiana Mizrahi (its Instagram). Not on chabad.org.

477093.name: Anexo Templo Etz Hajaim - Jabad
477093.note: Not in Jabad Argentina's list of its houses ('Batei Jabad', jabad.org.ar/beitjabad.asp) of Feb, April or 12 Aug 2001 (Wayback copies); in it by 1 Dec 2001 as 'Templo Etz Hajaim', next to Beit Jabad Villa Crespo; from 2004 'ANEXO TEMPLO ETZ HAJAIM - JABAD', Rabbi Iejiel Frenkel, Julián Álvarez 745. So about 2001. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14.

477080.name: Beis Chabad Palermo Soho
477080.note: Not in Jabad Argentina's list of its houses ('Batei Jabad', jabad.org.ar/beitjabad.asp) through 19 Feb 2006 (Wayback copies); in it by 6 April 2006 as 'BEIT JABAD PALERMO SOHO' (in Jan 2008: Rabino Tzvi Lipinski, Niceto Vega 5035). Its jabadsoho.com.ar domain was up by Nov 2006 and its chabad.org listing by Feb 2007. So about early 2006, 5766. Its new building at Malabia 2180: 'The 27th Chabad House in Buenos Aires, Argentina, will be inaugurated Thursday' (COLlive, 19 Aug 2009).

604253.name: Books & Judaica Showrooom
604253.note: Not in Jabad Argentina's list of its houses ('Batei Jabad', jabad.org.ar/beitjabad.asp) of 3 Oct 2003 (Wayback copy; the list had Editorial Kehot itself from 2001); in it by 2 Feb 2004: 'KEHOT LUBAVITCH SUDAMERICANA - SHOWROOM & JUDAICA', Cabrera 3102 (esq. Agüero). Low: it opened between Oct 2003 and Feb 2004, so 2004 or the end of 2003. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-12-28.

119910.name: Iarjo Jabad Lavalle
119910.note: Already in Jabad Argentina's first archived list of its houses (jabad.org.ar/beitjabad.asp, 5 Feb 2001) as 'Templo DR. Iarjo'; from 2005 'IARJO JABAD LAVALLE', Director: Rafael Lapidus, Lavalle 3934. Rabbi Rafael Lapidus (1954-2023): 'Durante décadas, se desempeñó como emisario del Rebe y Director de la sinagoga "Iarjo Jabad Lavalle"' (Esencia 42); Chabadpedia: after kollel he went out on shlichus in Buenos Aires, no year. Today Rabbi Yosef Itzjok Levy. No start found: by 2001.

477125.name: Beit Jabad Once - Litvische Shul
477125.note: Already in Jabad Argentina's first archived list of its houses (jabad.org.ar/beitjabad.asp, 5 Feb 2001) as 'Litvishe shul - Beit Jabad Once'; in 2008 'BEIT JABAD ONCE - LITVISCHE SHUL, Director: Rabino Aharón Stawsky, J. E. Uriburu 348'. Rabbi Stawsky died in 2012; his son-in-law Mendy Kapeluschnik took over with his wife (Periodismo Kosher, Oct 2013). No start found: by 2001.

120138.name: Tzivos Hashem
120138.note: 'Departamento de Tzivoth Hashem' of Beit Jabad Central is already in Jabad Argentina's first archived list (jabad.org.ar/beitjabad.asp, 5 Feb 2001); director Rabbi Israel Kapeluschnik in 2008-2017 (Chabadpedia: from 5760 he ran Tzivos Hashem). No start found: by 2001. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

159448.name: Beit Jabad Centro
159448.note: 'ANEXO BEIT JABAD CENTRO, 25 de Mayo 18, oficina 36, Centro de Córdoba Ciudad ... Rezo diario de minjá' of Beit Jabad Córdoba: not in Jabad Argentina's list of its houses of 6 Dec 2004, in it by 23 Jan 2005 (jabad.org.ar/beitjabad.asp, Wayback copies); but its chabad.org listing was up already on 2004-08-10. No start found: by 2004.

588981.name: Jabad Palermo Nuevo
588981.note: 'BEIT JABAD PALERMO NUEVO, Director: Rabino Mendy Grunblatt, Buschiazo 3028' (Jabad Argentina's list, 2012). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-11-01, though Jabad Argentina's old list of its houses (jabad.org.ar/beitjabad.asp) still did not have it in March 2009. No start found: by 2007.

extra-argentina-yerba-buena.name: Beit Jabad Kehilá de Yerba Buena
extra-argentina-yerba-buena.note: Beit Jabad Kehilá de Yerba Buena, Av. Aconquija 1071 (Tucumán): in the directory of Jabad Argentina's magazine Esencia from issue 42 (29 May 2023), not in issue 41 (March 2023); 'YERBA BUENA: Kehila - Av.Aconquija 1071' with Jabad Tucumán (its Facebook page, March 2024). The directory lags (Bajo Belgrano was in it months after it opened), so only: by 2023. Not on chabad.org.

3922564.name: Beis Chabad Chacarita
3922564.note: Beit Jabad Chacarita, Céspedes 3550 (Rabbi Yechezkel and Shifra Wildau; she died on 25 Iyar 5785, Esencia 50): 'Nueva comunidad Judía de Chacarita' (its Facebook page). At Av. Federico Lacroze 3815 in Feb 2020 (Periodismo Kosher). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2018-01-29, so by 2018.

3835668.name: Jabad Nordelta
3835668.note: JCC Jabad Nordelta (Rabbi Boruch Hagman, who managed Beit Jabad Almagro's areas in 2014, Itón Gadol); Boulevard del Mirador 106, Nordelta. Its Facebook group 'J.C.C. Jabad Nordelta' had its 'Primer "Breakfast entre mujeres"' on 8 March 2017 (search excerpt). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2017-11-03, so by 2017.

6773118.name: Jabad Resistencia
6773118.note: Rabbi Nochum and Rivka Freedman: 'The Freedmans made their first visit over Chanukah in 2023 ... They made the move to Resistencia in the summer of 2024' (lubavitch.com, 27 May 2026). 'El 9 de julio, llegaron al Chaco como los nuevos Shlujim de la ciudad', after a five-week visit and a return before Pesach (Esencia 51, Aug 2025): 9 July 2024, 3 Tammuz 5784. Jabad Argentina counts it among the openings of 5785 (Esencia 51). Rabbi Nochum Freedman is a son of Rabbi Moshe Freedman of Bahía Blanca (Chabadpedia). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2025-02-10.
